# stems-mcp — Full Documentation

Audio stem separation server using HTDemucs v4 via ONNX Runtime.

## Architecture

stems-mcp is a FastMCP 3.4+ server with dual transport (stdio + HTTP).
On first use it downloads the htdemucs.onnx model (~200 MB) from HuggingFace.
Inference runs on CUDA if available, falling back to CPU.

## Setup

```powershell
# Create venv and install deps with CUDA ONNX Runtime (requires CUDA toolkit)
uv sync --extra gpu

# Or CPU-only (extras conflict: pick exactly one)
uv sync --extra cpu
```

## Running

### stdio mode (default, for Claude Desktop / Cursor)
```powershell
uv run stems-mcp
```

### HTTP mode (for webapp / REST clients)
```powershell
uv run stems-mcp --mode http
# Server listens on http://127.0.0.1:11126
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| MCP_PORT | 11126 | HTTP transport port |
| MCP_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | Bind address |
| STEMS_MODEL_DIR | ~/.cache/stems-mcp | Model cache directory |

## Tools

### stems_separate

Portmanteau tool with 3 operations:

#### operation="separate"
Separates audio into 4 stems: vocals, drums, bass, other.
- input_path (str): Path to audio file
- output_dir (str): Directory for output WAV files

#### operation="separate_vocals"
Two-stem separation: vocals + other.
- input_path (str): Path to audio file
- output_dir (str): Directory for output WAV files

#### operation="status"
Returns model cache status and available ONNX providers (CUDA/CPU).

## REST API

- GET /api/health — Server health, uptime, provider info
- GET /api/v1/diagnostics — Full diagnostics with tool list and model status

## Model Details

- **Architecture**: Hybrid Transformer Demucs (HTDemucs) v4
- **Format**: ONNX (ops=17, float32)
- **Source**: https://huggingface.co/StemSplitio/htdemucs-onnx (MIT, SHA-256 verified on download)
- **Size**: 316 MB (316,446,953 bytes)
- **Contract**: input `mix` [1, 2, 343980] -> output `stems` [1, 4, 2, 343980], order drums/bass/other/vocals
- **Cache**: ~/.cache/stems-mcp/htdemucs.onnx

## Supported Audio Formats

All formats supported by soundfile: WAV, FLAC, OGG, AIFF, etc.
Input is resampled to 44.1 kHz stereo internally (mono is duplicated); stems are written as 44.1 kHz stereo PCM_24 WAV.

## Ports

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 11126 | MCP HTTP / REST API backend |
| 11127 | Webapp frontend (reserved) |
